title: Ravina bar Yirmeyah
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Avodah Zarah 50b, where Rav Sama son of Rav Ashi raised an objection to him. Hyman reports that Dikdukei Soferim deletes “bar Yirmeyah” and calls the Gilyon HaShas proposal to read Rabbah bar Yirmeyah a scribal error.[^1]

notes.text: The complete Avodah Zarah 50b paragraph explicitly has Rav Sama son of Rav Ashi addressing Ravina bar Yirmeyah. Hyman’s report of deletion in Dikdukei Soferim and his rejection of the Gilyon HaShas replacement remain attributed apparatus claims, not a fresh collation, printed-letter inspection or correction-history finding.
